newsitem.title: USA: Koll to appeal possible Nasdaq delisting.
newsitem.headline: Koll to appeal possible Nasdaq delisting.

text.p: Koll Real Estate Group Inc said it has been notified by the Nasdaq Stock Market Inc that Nasdaq may delist its Class A common stock and Series A Convertible Preferred Stock due to a failure to meet listing requirements.
The company said it has appealed the possible delisting.
Nasdaq said it may delist the issues as a result of Koll's net tangible assets falling below $4 million as of December 31, 1996.

Koll said that it will easily meet Nasdaq's continued listing criteria upon a successful completion of its previously announced exchange offer of common stock for about $200 million of outstanding debt.
The company said that until its appeal is heard on April 23 and a final decision is reached, the company's securities will continued to be listed on Nasdaq's National Market.
Koll said it expects the appeal process will be completed within about 30 days.
